- File: .github/workflows/implement.yml
  Line or code reference: lines 3401-3406 (the `if ! gh label create ... && ! gh label edit ...` block) and the immediately-following `gh issue edit` (lines 3372-3375 in the current file)
  Problem: The label ensure step uses `&&` between `create` and `edit` (both redirected to `/dev/null`). When the label already exists (the common idempotent case), `create` fails → the `&&` short-circuits and `edit` is never executed.
  Why it fails at runtime: Consumer repos whose `ai:destructive-blocked` label was created with a stale description (or edited by another workflow) will never have the documented contract description restored, even though the PR description and inline comments claim the path guarantees contract compliance. The redispatch gate only checks label *name*, but RC-2 (and the label_contract) requires the full metadata. Copilot comment at line 3387 (previous round) correctly flagged this; the current implementation still does not restore `--description` on the `edit` path when `create` fails first.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: .github/workflows/implement.yml
  Line or code reference: lines 3409-3417 (the `if latched_labels=...` verification block) + the manual-remediation command printed in the `::error::` branch
  Problem: When `gh issue view` fails (rate-limit, network, permission, transient API error), the block emits only `::warning::` and the operator comment still says “verify that the label is present”. The printed remediation command does *not* guarantee the description is restored on a repo that already has the label (it uses `edit || create` but the order is reversed from the ensure block and can still leave stale metadata).
  Why it fails at runtime: Exactly the RC-2 consumer failure case (label never created or verification read fails) produces an inaccurate operator message and a remediation command that does not idempotently restore the contract. The three-way branch improves on the original `|| true` swallow but leaves the unknown-state leaf under-hardened.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
